description: Builds scroll-linked motion effects — depth-layer parallax, sticky pinning, scroll-triggered reveals, horizontal scroll-jacking, pointer/mouse parallax, scale-on-scroll, velocity-aware marquees, and native CSS scroll-driven animation (animation-timeline) — with performance and accessibility handled from the first line of code, not bolted on after. Activates when the user asks for parallax scrolling, scroll animations, scroll-triggered effects, depth on scroll, sticky sections, pinned sections, horizontal scroll sections, scroll-jacking, mouse or pointer parallax, animate on scroll, reveal on scroll, scroll-linked motion, or a landing page/hero that should "feel alive" while scrolling. Covers four implementation stacks — vanilla CSS/JS, native CSS scroll-timelines, GSAP ScrollTrigger, and Motion (the library formerly named Framer Motion) for React — and picks between them by tradeoff, not by default. Check this before writing any scroll-linked animation, even a single fade-in-on-scroll.
